name: The Sigil Given by Lan Yan
desc: After recreating the art jointly devised by the Wind Reader and Silverwing, Lan Yan gave you the sigil used to perform it. Together, you found a sense of fulfillment in something that had seemed destined to end in regret — a memory well worth commemorating.
